claims: The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is closed on April 3, 2026 in observance of Good Friday.
There will be no trading activity on April 3, 2026.
The U.S. stock market will reopen for regular trading hours on April 6, 2026.
The U.S. bond market is closed on April 3, 2026.
Several foreign exchanges are closed on April 3, 2026.
Most banks are operating normally on April 3, 2026.
The U.S. Postal Service is operating normally on April 3, 2026.
UPS is operating normally on April 3, 2026.
FedEx is operating normally on April 3, 2026.
Good Friday is not a federal holiday.
Good Friday is a traditional trading holiday for the stock market.
